metadata.modeling_rule: Organizational self-description does not automatically convert every hosted, linked, or authored article into an institutional position.

positions.summary: Jude 3 & the PCA describes itself as an independent voice consisting of PCA members and says it has operated since 2021.
Jude 3 & the PCA says it works for the glory of Christ through pastoral and confessional accountability within the PCA.
The organization says its earlier work primarily aggregated articles, blogs, podcasts, and other media while maintaining an archive of resources.
positions.boundary: Aggregation and archiving are not treated as endorsement of every claim in the aggregated source.

positions.summary: Jude 3 & the PCA says it is shifting its priority toward publishing and distributing more original content rather than primarily highlighting material published by others.
Jude 3 & the PCA invites submissions from PCA officers and members aimed at encouraging confessional fidelity, integrity, and vitality.
Jude 3 & the PCA says it continues to sponsor The Westminster Standard Podcast as part of its publishing activity.
